{{Top|leg}}
'''Rhador''' was a village that had been in existence for over a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Several villagers ended up protesting the Empire, only to end up flash frozen and [[Massacre at Rhador|destroyed]] by the Empire's [[Carbonite war droid]]s.
